lines.en: Every step of mine grinds the ground.
This body is tall and white.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但方向明确
lines.en: I walk slowly, with purpose.
One sweep of my tail tilts a tree.
The wood won't stop me; I push through.
My foreclaws are short; useless for walking.

lines.zh: 我的影子比一片地还长
lines.en: My shadow is longer than a patch of ground.
I leave deep pits behind.
I need no concealment.
I walk toward the fences.
Every step brings me closer.
I'm in no hurry.
My steps echo through the wood.
I stand taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 我在听，很轻的声音也听得到
lines.en: I'm listening; even faint sounds.

lines.zh: 我身上的白皮有旧裂痕
lines.en: Old scars cross my white hide.
I lower my head.

lines.zh: 这一片林子里没有我的同类
lines.en: There's no kin of mine in this wood.
The fences are too low.
I mark the wind's direction.
My teeth are more use than my foreclaws.
No one can put me back.
This land is mine.
My breathing is deep.

lines.zh: 我的眼在暗处也看得清
lines.en: My eyes see clearly in the dark.
I fear nothing.
You shouldn't stand in front of me.
Where's the fence? I pushed it over.
You're shorter than those fences.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看得很清楚
lines.en: I raise my head and see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我的前爪短，可我的牙长
lines.en: Short foreclaws, long teeth.

lines.zh: 我这一身不是长出来的
lines.en: This body wasn't grown.
You think a cage holds me.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你藏在哪块石头后。
lines.en: I smell which rock you're hiding behind.
That thing in your hand is too short.

lines.zh: 你以为我是这里最大的，我是
lines.en: You think I'm the biggest thing here. I am.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我耳里很响
lines.en: Your steps are loud to my ears.
I took a step back and snapped a tree.
That hit my white hide.
I don't cry out; I only get angrier.
The wound's on my shoulder.
Blood drips on the ground, hot.
One leg of mine sagged once.
You hit hard.
This wound only makes me hungrier.
That scrap can't fill these teeth.

lines.zh: 你把这东西举起来，很可笑
lines.en: You raise that; it's absurd.
I want something that runs.
Keep the meat.
I need no one to feed me.
That won't buy your life.

lines.zh: 我是被造出来的，不吃这个
lines.en: I was made; I don't want that.
Put the meat down and back off.
I'm looking at you, not the meat.

lines.zh: 撞上来，你连退都来不及
lines.en: Run into me and you won't even get to back away.
These bones are far heavier than you.
Don't stand close; if I move, you fall.
That brought the fence down.
I turned half around and the ground shook.
You're pinned to the tree.
I don't dodge; I'm too big.
You're standing in my footprint.
Move, I'm coming through.
I put no force into that.

lines.zh: 我是造出来的，没有同类
lines.en: I was made; I have no kind.
I'm the only one on this island.
I treat it as a territory matter.

lines.zh: 我的地盘从围栏到围栏
lines.en: My range runs fence to fence.
What do you want to see?

lines.zh: 我一个人就够这片地受的
lines.en: I alone are enough for this land.
Not a sound; the wood answers back.
Go away.
I take it in my teeth.
This much isn't enough.
My foreclaws are too short to pick it up.
It's a pebble at my feet.
I lower my head and it's gone.
Fallen things are mine.
Not worth a glance.
Leave it.
Something's moving past the fence.

lines.zh: 它站在围栏边上，我看见了
lines.en: It's by the fence line; I see it.
A few steps and I'm there.
The wind brings the scent.
I don't need to hide.
First, knock down this fence.
It's so much smaller than me.
There's no other way out.

lines.zh: 我把头压到树冠那么低
lines.en: I bring my head down to canopy height.
Just that one.

lines.zh: 它一跑，我就知道它怕了
lines.en: The moment it ran, I knew it was afraid.
The gap in the fence opened; now.
One step of mine is ten of its.
It circled to the far side of the tree.
That tree won't stop me.
I press it toward the fence.
I'm slow; it's slower.
My shadow already covers it.
I lower my head, teeth forward.
It's shouting.
It's backed into the corner.
It's shaking.
I smell the fear.
One step more.
Right at this instant.
I bite down.
A shake of my head throws it.
My foot comes down and the ground sinks.
My tail cracks the fence.

lines.zh: 我这一口下去，骨头会断
lines.en: One bite of mine and bone breaks.
It struck a trunk.
I drive it into the wall.
Blood in my mouth.
It's still moving; one more bite.
I bite again.
That pinned it.
I straighten and look at it.
I knocked the fence down.
I lower my head again.
That wasn't a threat.
After that, it stopped moving.
A section of fence fell first.

lines.zh: 我从围栏的缺口挤出来
lines.en: I squeeze through the gap in the fence.
The cage couldn't hold me.

lines.zh: 我是用 DNA 拼出来的
lines.en: I was pieced together from DNA.
The wind here is unfamiliar.
I raise my head first.
Several big prints on the ground.
No one's come to feed me.
This place is bigger than the cage.

lines.zh: 笼子是我们造的，我也是
lines.en: They built the cage, and me too.
My white hide still carries scars.
I settle and the ground dips.
I head for the fence.
Today it's my turn.
Fire singed my hide; I don't care.
I fell from height and my legs buckled.

lines.zh: 水太浅，淹不到我的膝盖
lines.en: The water's too shallow to reach my knees.
The blast pushed me back half a step.

lines.zh: 一根东西扎进皮里，像根刺
lines.en: Something stuck in my hide like a thorn.
The spell hit and I stiffened.
I'm hungry, and hunger makes me worse.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，白皮更白
lines.en: Lightning struck and my white hide went whiter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地，我照样往下
lines.en: No ground in the void; I fall on.
